role: Declares the placement port: the placer pose and placed stack structs, place_try (ItemStack.tryPlaceItemIntoWorld), the would-use query the client swing reads, the per-case stream setup, and the rail, tripwire, torch, portal-frame, fire and drop helpers blockcb.c calls.

structs.name: struct placer
structs.java: EntityPlayerMP posX, posY, posZ, rotationYaw, rotationPitch, yOffset

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
notes: EntityPlayerMP's fields named for struct placer are inherited from Entity; the path is the placer class the header names. place_torch_can_support is declared here but its definition lives in blockcb.c.
